title: 101st Airborne Division Refuels for Hurricane Florence Relief
description: U.S. Army Soldiers assigned to 129th Combat Support Sustainment Battalion, 101st Airborne Division (Air Assault), and 101st Airborne Division Sustainment Brigade "Lifeliners" arrive at Fort Bragg, NC to join the ongoing operations conducted by Fort Bragg units in support of Hurricane Florence relief efforts, Sept. 16, 2018. The 101st ABN Soldiers made the 22 hour trip from Fort Campbell, KY, leaving yesterday and arriving moments ago. (U.S. Army video by PFC Luke Steward)
